subject: CIQA status: sampling pipeline done, one distribution risk
body:
Hi both,

Status: the sampling pipeline is reproducible end to end. We filter AVA to sources with JPEG quality factor >= 99 and recompress each at two random quality factors, matching the original study. Good news is the semantic balance holds - the eight classes (animal, architecture, cityscape, floral, food/drink, landscape, portrait, still life) each land at roughly 6.25% after sampling, so no reweighting needed.

The risk: the near-lossless filter is stricter than I expected and our usable pool came out at ~41k images. If Lucia wants per-class metric confidence intervals under +/-2%, the May rater wave needs to cover more pairs per image than we budgeted - I estimate 15-20% more judgments. Options: eat the cost, or drop the two weakest classes from the launch claim.

Also flagging that rater tooling had a two week slip, Leilani has it back on track.

Milan
